description: RSMeans Data is described on its site as North America's leading construction estimating database, used for more than 80 years to estimate costs of new building construction and renovation with localised pricing. It is offered as RSMeans Data Online in three tiers with quarterly updates to all cost elements, as printed cost books (the 2027 books were on pre-order in September 2026), through job order contracting tools, and through an AI early-stage estimating product; it is certified on the Gordian Federal Cloud. Users include pre-construction managers, architects, engineers and contractors, and researchers who compare in-house costs against it. Coverage: the United States and Canada, with location factors. Access: online subscription and books, with a free trial. Licence: commercial; paid. Caveats: data are proprietary, and unit costs are averages that need local adjustment. Simulation uses are construction and repair cost inputs for building loss functions, retrofit cost-benefit studies and capital planning. Related records: BCIS cost data for the UK.
